message:
Draft almanac ready for review. It is a first compile, so there is no previous version to compare. File to save: almanac-2026-11-22-v1.md in Board Documents/Almanac. Sources: 4 files processed, 0 excluded, 0 recordings.

GUEST FEES (new topic, no existing topic fits)
- Current rule: $15 per guest visit, effective 2024-04-01. Set by committee minutes 2024-03-05, motion carried 3-1. Quote (committee-minutes-2024-03-05.docx): "the guest fee is raised to $15 per visit, effective April 1, 2024. Motion carried 3-1."
- Replaced: $10 per visit (club-rules-2022.pdf, "Each guest pays a fee of $10 per visit."). The rules say they may be amended by a majority vote of the committee; I record that threshold and the vote, and do not rule on validity.
- Corrected: the notice of 2024-03-20 stated $12. Committee minutes 2024-06-11 say that notice misstated the fee and the adopted fee is $15.

POOL AND AMENITIES
- Weekday court booking: no more than 2 hours per day, effective 2022-03-01 (club-rules-2022.pdf, "A member may book a court for no more than two hours per day.")
- Weekend court booking: no more than 90 minutes per day, decision date 2024-03-05, motion carried 4-0. No effective date is stated in the minutes. Quote: "on Saturdays and Sundays a member may book a court for no more than 90 minutes per day. Weekday booking is unchanged."
- CONFLICT, court hours: club-rules-2022.pdf says "Courts are open from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. every day." notice-2024-03-20.txt says "Courts are now open from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m." No later adopted document explains the difference, so this stays open. A motion to extend hours to 10:00 p.m. failed 2-2 on 2024-03-05.

GOVERNANCE AND AMENDMENTS
- Club rules adopted at the members' meeting of 2022-03-01: "Adopted at the members' meeting of March 1, 2022. Effective March 1, 2022." Amendment threshold: "These rules may be amended by a majority vote of the committee."

OPEN ITEMS: none. The documents state no action items, owners, due dates or contract deadlines.

EXCLUSIONS: none. Scheduled changes: none.
